upheld.title: Shared footer/header change not exercised on any signed-in route
upheld.detail: FooterBar (Back to top link, href built by NavigationManager) and HeaderBar (#top anchor) render on every route through MainLayout. The e2e spec only renders / and /item/{id}. No test asserts the link or its href on a signed-in route such as /cart or /user/orders, so AC1 ('any page') is only partly
upheld.requirement: Given any page of the store, when the shopper looks at the footer's bottom row, then it shows a "Back to top" link next to the legal links.
